title: My Trickster+Ragnarok online inspired game
author: iloveloon
selftext:
Hi everyone, I want to share my dream of making Trickster online + Ragnarok online but with my take of classic approach like no auto play, 0.2-0.5% rare drop, each mobs has worthwhile drop like card and unique hat, no combat power, no pay for power, no pile of useless equipment with tier or color like green purple etc. 

So I start planning for art direction and I want something cute but crisp, clear and I kinda got this artstyle which I think pretty cute for my taste and of course it's made with AI but it's not easy at all, each monster and player animation got reiterate hundreds of time and I can't even think about how much I have to pay if I hire human artist.

here's my little snippet of how the game feels so please tell me what do you think, is it still feel ai-slop ? is it ugly despite my effort to make it look great ? do you want to play this based on what you see? your feedback will be greatly appreciate, thank you.

ดูน้อยลง

comments.author: Lucky-Sherbert8976
comments.body: bro i am literally making my own version of this! looks awesome so far! good job man

replies.author: iloveloon
replies.body: Wow thank you for your kind words

comments.author: ChirpXel
comments.body: Looks very cute! Has a nice vibe. Looking forward to seeing updates so we get more a complete game taste!

replies.author: iloveloon
replies.body: Thank you for your feedback !! I'll upload more.

comments.author: thetinytrex
comments.body: Ahaha I literally posted my own game also inspired by Ragnarok Online. I didn't go classic route because I wouldn't have time to play it myself. This looks really nice and cozy! You really captured the classic feel. One of the things I loved about classic RO are the rare drops and hats. Do you have more to showcase? Do you have a character customization screen? Curious how you handle the different sprites for your character.

replies.author: iloveloon
replies.body: Thank you for your reply ! I currently have 6 maps + 1 pyramid dungeon with various mobs. character customization I have to compromise and made only hat + hair accessory + weapon switch because I don't have enough skill to make complete spine system.

replies.author: thetinytrex
replies.body:
That's awesome. You said the sprites were made with AI? Is it just Codex/ChatGPT? I'm curious about your workflow to get the sprites with interchangeable hat, accessory, and weapon. 

Also, I just looked up Trickster Online and realized that OH MY GOD I used to play it a lot back in college. I forgot the name of the game and really loved Trickster. I can still remember playing with the Lion with a glass cannon build and farming the Phantom school. I remember spending my hard earned part-time money to buy some in-game housing. Thanks for the nostalgia trip. Man I miss that game.

replies.author: iloveloon
replies.body: Yeah it's pure AI it's ChatGPT + [mage.space](http://mage.space) video creation and lots of iteration, on interchangeable hat I have ChatGPT generate hat then have claude make tool for editing sprite frame by frame so this one is manual, on weapon I make it a magenta rod then animate in [mage.space](http://mage.space) then have claude map those magenta pixel and swap with actual weapon from ChatGPT

comments.author: Tkwan777
comments.body: This is why AI dev gets a bad name. You basically used the same sheep from trickster. It's not your unique design.

replies.author: iloveloon
replies.body: I know sorry, at first I plan to make complete trickster rip off and the sheep is the result of that, but now I have my original owl librarian as magic representative instead.

comments.author: ProtectingMaPrivacy
comments.body: Man. Ragnarok online. What a throwback

comments.author: clydeagain
comments.body:
Holy crap this looks polished!! I'm actually making a Trickster inspired non-combat RPG game myself and focusing on drilling and merchanting aspect of it.

Are your characters all front/side facing only? I'm thinking if I should change it so it's that way as well since designing and animating the back side will be difficult. Also you absolutely nailed the art and vibe, mind sharing how they were created?

replies.author: iloveloon
replies.body: Thank you !! at first I made front/back but it's really double my animation time and so inconsistent so I decide to scrap it. I create sprite with ChatGPT and animate in [mage.space](http://mage.space), the hard part is I'm cheap and use minimax h3 turbo and one animation need like hundreds of iteration till I think it's good enough
